note: Rare+ procedural names = first + second, e.g. Hushbloom, Mothwick. Mirrors config.name_parts.

items.name: The Bellringer's Toll
items.flavor: It still rings, faintly, when no one is listening.

items.name: Drowned Lantern
items.flavor: Wet, cold, and somehow still burning.

items.name: Tolly's Morning Note
items.flavor: One bright DONG. Everybody up!

items.name: The Warden's Big Helmet
items.flavor: Two sizes too big. You'll grow into it.

items.name: The Unfinished Scarf
items.flavor: Long enough for a whole village. Nearly.

items.name: Squelchstriders
items.flavor: They squelch. Proudly.

items.name: The Last Warm Wick
items.flavor: A Candle Mage gave it back. Politely.

items.name: Rattler's Nightcap
items.flavor: Rattlebones sleep better in it. So do you.

items.name: Mother Bark's Shadow Jar
items.flavor: Empty now. It hums a lullaby anyway.

items.name: Birchwhisper
items.flavor: Each arrow tells a rumour on the way.

items.name: The Owlcrow's Eye
items.flavor: It always looks your way. Kindly, now.

items.name: Puffcap Hood
items.flavor: Sneeze-proof. Sparkle-positive.

items.name: Good Dog Collar
items.flavor: For the goodest hound in the Whisperwood.

items.name: Hob's Carved Acorn
items.flavor: The rune on it says 'grow'. It's trying.

items.name: Crown of Sticks
items.flavor: Twiglings bow when they see it. Then they poke it.

items.name: Dig Deep
items.flavor: It hums the first line of an old song.

items.name: Dig Bright
items.flavor: It hums the second line.

items.name: Clinking Silk Gloves
items.flavor: If they go quiet, check the ceiling.

items.name: Cart Six's Wheel
items.flavor: It always comes back.

items.name: Annie's Shawl
items.flavor: Warm. Warm.

items.name: Salty Heart
items.flavor: Tough on the outside. Salty in the middle.

items.name: The Going-Up Lever
items.flavor: Ding! Next stop: trouble.

items.name: The Everlasting Toast
items.flavor: Raised a year. Finished at last.

items.name: Warmhearth Crown
items.flavor: It thaws anyone who wears it. Especially inside.

items.name: The Sorry Tray
items.flavor: Serves trap tea. Deeply apologises.

items.name: Porcelain Smile
items.flavor: It only moves when you're not looking.

items.name: Tinwhistle's Medal
items.flavor: For bravery. And for saluting anvils.

items.name: Pip's Bossy Tiara
items.flavor: Royal orders, kindly given.

items.name: Chimney Kid's Hood
items.flavor: Smells of soot and adventure.

items.name: Jin-Jin
items.flavor: Frozen jester bells. They only get halfway.

items.name: Nobody's Spare Hat
items.flavor: …  (It is a very good hat.)

items.name: Quiet Stair Slippers
items.flavor: Every step leaves a little light.

items.name: The Hollow Choir's Bell
items.flavor: Rings without a sound. The Hush hears it.

items.name: Pell's Wick-Trimmers
items.flavor: Snip. Snip. Every night. For so long.

items.name: The Ninety-Ninth Chair
items.flavor: Someone finally sat in it.

items.name: Lastlight Lens
items.flavor: Makes small lights look very, very big.

items.name: The Stirring Ladle
items.flavor: Stir left for luck.

items.name: Nib's Borrowing Glove
items.flavor: Borrows gold. Permanently. Legally.

items.name: Magpie's Hoard Key
items.flavor: Opens a door that isn't there. Sometimes.

items.name: Cloak of a Thousand Wings
items.flavor: Soft. Fluttery. Slightly ticklish.

items.name: The Wandering Spark
items.flavor: The first thing that ever remembered.

items.name: Mantle of the Long Shadow
items.flavor: Every shadow wants to be close to a light.

items.name: The Morning That Never Came
items.flavor: Forged for a dawn that was cancelled. It is still waiting.
items.how: Rekindle all of Act V without your lantern going out once.

items.name: Grandmother's Needles
items.flavor: She knitted a scarf for every child in the village. The last one was never finished.
items.how: From the Tenth Lantern, on in-game full-moon nights.

items.name: The Bell That Doesn't Ring
items.flavor: The quietest bell in the world. The Snuffed hear it anyway.
items.how: Stand still for 30 seconds while the Great Echo copies you.

items.name: The Owl's Last Question
items.flavor: The answer isn't in any book. We checked. All the books.
items.how: Answer 50 Owlcrow riddles in a row, then say 'I don't know'.

items.name: The Frog King's Croak
items.flavor: Every bolt croaks. That's not a bug. It's tradition.
items.how: Find it on a Wickmire lily pad in the rain. Walk. Don't run.
